༄༅/ /grub mtha' kun gyi snying po'i don bsdus pa blo gsal 'jug pa'i khang bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: /grub mtha' kun gyi snying po'i don bsdus pa blo gsal 'jug pa'i khang bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs/ na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ gzhung lugs kun la lta ba'i mig gi mchog / rigs lam man ngag tshogs dang cha shas kyang*/ /ster mdzad yongs su 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen rnams/ /dran pa yis kyang dad pa'i spu long g.yo/ /rang sde'i grub mtha' spyi dang khyad par rnams/ /mkhas grub rnams kyi bzhed pa ji bzhin du/ /don bsdus go sla'i ngag gis 'dir bshad kyi/ /gzur gnas blo ldan mchis na 'jug par rigs/ gnyis pa rang sde'i grub mtha'i rnam par bzhag pa la gnyis/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ so sor bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rang sde'i grub mtha' thun mong ba rnam pa bzhir nges pa yin te/ bye brag smra ba/ mdo sde ba/ sems tsam pa/ dbu ma pa'i grub mtha' dang bzhir nges pa'i phyir te/ rigs ldan grags pas/ bye brag smra dang mdo sde pa/ /rnal 'byor spyod dang dbu ma ba/ /'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi bo de dag kyang bsdu na theg pa che chung gi grub mtha' gnyis su 'du ba yin te/ bye mdo gnyis kyi grub mtha' ni theg dman gyi grub mtha' dang*/ dbu sems gnyis kyi grub mtha' ni theg chen gyi grub mthar 'du ba'i phyir/ theg pa che chung gnyis kyi shing rta'i srol gang gis phye snyam na/ de yang klu sgrub kyis dbu ma pa dang*/ thogs med kyi sems tsam pa'i shing rta'i srol phye zhing de gnyis kas kyang theg chen gyi shing rta'i srol phye ba/ de'i zhar byung du theg dman gyi grub mtha' la bltos pa'i shing rta'i srol yang phye ba yin no/ /grub mtha' bzhi bo so so nas rang rang gi lugs de ston pa sangs rgyas kyi rang lugs dang*/ rang gi lugs de yang rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis dang ma 'dres par 'dod la/ de lta na'ang*/ gzhan sde phyi rol pas/ rtag pa'i bdag sogs khas blangs pa ni/ rang sde bye brag smra bas 'gog cing*/

bye brag smra bas 'dus ma byas la rdzas grub 'dod pa de/ mdo sde pas 'gog /des rang mtshan rnams rang rang gi ming gi tha snyad kyi gzhir gnas tshod kyi dbang gis grub par 'dod pa de/ sems tsam pas 'gog /sems tsam pas dngos po bden grub tu 'dod pa de/ dbu ma pas 'gog pas grub mtha' 'og ma 'og ma las gong ma gong ma mchog yin no/ / des na grub mtha' bzhi bo rnams las snga ma rnams phyi ma'i stegs su 'gyur te/ de'i tshul yang phyi rol bas bdag dang skye ba snga phyi lta bu 'jog ma shes la/ bye smras de ltar shes pa de/ mdo sde pas 'dus byas pa dang 'dus ma byas la btags yod 'jog shes pa'i stegs dang*/ mdo sde pas de ltar shes pa de/ sems tsam pa chos thams cad rang nyid rang nyid zhes pa'i tha snyad 'jug pa'i gzhir rang dbang gis ma grub kyang bya byed 'thad pa dang*/ kun btags rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ma grub par 'jog shes pa'i stegs dang*/ sems tsam pas de ltar shes pa ste/ dbu ma pas chos thams cad ming brdas bzhag pa las gzhan du bden par grub pa rdul tsam yang med pa la bya byed 'thad par go ba'i stegs su 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar mchog dman gyi khyad par yod kyang*/ de gsung ba po'i sangs rgyas la nye ring yod pa sogs kyi skyon min gyi/ gdul bya la dbang bo mchog dman yod pas de dag rim gyis sangs rgyas kyi sar bkri ba'i thabs yin te de ltar yang*/ 'phags pa yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa las/ stong ba zhi ba skye ba med pa'i tshul/ /mi shes pas ni 'gro ba 'khyams gyur ba/ /de dag thugs rje mnga' ba'i thabs tshul dang*/ /rigs pa brgya dag gis ni 'dzud par mdzad/ zhes pa dang*/ rin chen phreng ba las kyang*/ brda sprod pa dag ji lta bus/ /yi ge'i phyi mo zlog 'jug ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas gdul bya la/ /ci tsam bzod pa'i chos ston to/ /zhes pa nas/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying bo can/

/ byang chub sgrub pa kha cig la'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ de lta na'ang dbu ma pa gnyis las thal 'gyur ba'i lugs ni/ lugs gzhan thams cad las mchog tu gyur ba yin te/ rtag chad kyi mtha' dag dang bral ba'i lugs rnam par dag pa yin pa'i phyir te/ dpal ldan zla bas/ lugs 'di ni gzhan dang thun mong min pa'o zhes sogs dang*/ rje bla mas/ yod dang med pa'i mtha' spangs pa/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ nang ba'i thun mong gi grub mtha' la bzhir nges pas de smra ba'i gang zag la yang bzhir nges la/ de dag ni 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa so sor bshad pa la bzhi/ bye brag smra ba/ mdo sde pa/ sems tsam pa/ dbu ma ba'i grub mtha' 'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ dbye ba/ grub mtha'i 'dod tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rang rig mi 'dod cing phyi don yod par bden zhen gyis 'dod pa'i theg dman gyi grub mtha' smra ba'i gang zag bye brag smra ba'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ bye brag bshad mtsho chen mo'i rjes su 'brang ba dang*/ dus gsum rdzas kyi bye brag tu smra bas na/ bye brag smra ba'o/ /gsum pa de la dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas kha che bye brag smra ba dang*/ nyi 'og bye brag smra ba gnyis/ gyes tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na sde ba bco brgyad yod de/ thog mar rtsa ba'i sde ba gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba/ phal chen pa/ gnas brtan pa/ mang bos bkur ba'i sde ba dang bzhir gnas pa la/ dang po las bdun/ gnyis pa las lnga/ gsum pa las gsum/ bzhi pa las kyang gsum ste bco brgyad du gyes pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'di la yang 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba du ma yod kyang slob dpon dul ba lha ltar na/ ji skad du/ 'od srungs ston chos srung ste/ /mang thos gos dmar slob ma dang*/ /rnam par phye dang gzhi kun pa/ /thams cad yod par smra ba bdun/ /shar nub ri dang gangs rir gnas/ /'dus byas rtag par smra ba dang*/ /'jig rten 'das smra phal chen sde/

/rgyal byed tshal gnas 'jigs med gnas/ /gtsug lag khang chen gnas brtan gsum/ /sa sgrogs ri dang srung ba pa/ /gnas ma bu pa'i sde rnams ni/ /kun gyis bkur ba rnam pa gsum/ /zhes bshad pa ltar ro/ /'di dag gi khyad par rgyas par ni 'dul ba sogs nas shes par bya zhing theg dman gyi gang zag dang theg dman gyi grub mtha' smra ba'i gang zag la ni khyad par yod pa yang shes dgos so/ /bzhi ba grub mtha'i 'dod tshul la gsum/ gzhi dang*/ lam dang*/ 'bras bu'o/ /dang po bzhi la rgyas par phye na gzugs tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed rnam shes kyi phung bo ste phung bo lnga/ mig rna ba sna lce lus te dbang bo lnga/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ste skye mched lnga dang rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs rnams 'dus byas dang*/ nam mkha' dang 'gog pa gnyis 'dus ma byas so/ khams bco brgyad 'dod de/ gzugs nas chos khams kyi bar yul gyi khams drug /mig nas yid kyi bar rten gyi khams drug /mig gi rnam shes nas yid kyi rnam shes kyi bar gyi rnam shes kyi khams drug ste drug gsum bco brgyad 'dod pas so/ /skye mched bcu gnyis kyang 'dod de/ gzugs sgra sogs yul gyi skye mched drug /mig sogs dbang bo'i skye mched drug ste bcu gnyis 'dod pa'i phyir/ de yang phung bor spungs pas na phung bo/ /skye ba'i sgo yin pas na skye mched/ /chos de'i rigs yin pas na khams zhes bya'o shes bya thams cad khams bco brgyad dang*/ skye mched bcu gnyis su 'dus par 'dod la/ 'di tsam zhig ni grub mtha' gong ma thams cad dang thun mong du khas len no/ /der ma zad 'gro ba lnga/ skye gnas bzhi sogs bzhed la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ 'dis dngos po la rtag pa'i dngos po dang*/ mi rtag pa'i dngos po gnyis 'dod pa'i snga ma ni/ nam mkhas rlung brten pa'i don byed nus pa lta bu ste/ cig shos ni sla'o/

/des na don byed nus pa dang shes bya don gcig par bzhed ces gsung*/ shes bya'am dngos po la dbye na/ bden pa gnyis su yod/ bcom pa'am blos cha shas so sor bsal ba na rang 'dzin gyi blo 'dor du rung ba'i chos rnams ni kun rdzob bden pa yin la/ bsam don ni mtshon na/ rdza bum lta bu zhig ma bshig pa'i gnas skabs su de la bum pa'o snyam pa'i blo skye yang*/ bshig pa'i tshe de la bum pa'i blo mi skye bas na/ rdza bum dang de'i nang gi chu lta bu ni kun rdzob bden pa yin te/ mdzod las/ gang la bcom dang blo yis gzhan/ /bsal na de blo mi 'jug pa/ /bum chu bzhin du kun rdzob tu/ /yod de/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bcom pa'am blos cha shas so sor bsal ba na rang 'dzin gyi blo mi 'dor ba'i chos rnams don dam bden pa yin la/ bsam don ni sngar gyi zlog phyogs kyis shes shing*/ mtshan gzhi ni/ gzugs dang tshor ba lta bu/ gzhan yang rdul phran cha med/ shes pa skad cig cha med/ 'dus byas cha med rnams so/ /kun rdzob dang btags yod don gcig la/ don dam bden pa dang rdzas yod don gcig par 'dod do/ /gang zag rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod kyis stong ba de gang zag gi bdag med phra mor 'dod cing*/ gnas ma bu pas de 'dra'i stong ba de gang zag gi bdag med phra mor mi 'dod kyang*/ rtag gcig rang dbang can gyis stong ba de bdag med phra mor 'dod la/ chos kyi bdag med zhes pa'i tha snyad khas mi len no/ /phung bo'i rgyun dang*/ tshogs pa dang*/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa 'ga' zhig gang zag tu khas len pa dang*/ mngon sum dang rjes dpag tshad ma khas len kyang*/ dbang bo gzugs can pa ni tshad mar 'dod do/ / 'di dang mdo sde pa kha cig theg chen gyi mdo bkar mi 'dod kyang 'dod pa'ang yod ces gsung*/ gnyis pa lam la gnyis/ spang bya dang*/ lam dngos so/ /dang po ni/ sgrib pa la nyon mongs can dang*/ nyon mongs can yin pa'i sgrib pa'am mun pa gnyis 'dod kyang*/

shes sgrib kyi tha snyad ni khas len par ma bshad/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin dang*/ de las byung ba'i nyon mongs rnams nyon mongs can gyi sgrib pa yin la/ de dag gi bag chags dang*/ de'i dbang gis byung ba'i gnas ngan len rnams nyon mongs can min pa'o/ /gnyis pa lam dngos la/ tshogs sbyor gyi lam gnyis/ mthong sgom gyi lam gnyis/ mi slob lam ste lnga 'dod la/ yang dran pa nyer gzhag nas 'phags lam yan lag gi bar byang phyogs so bdun sogs 'dod cing*/ 'on kyang sa bcu dang longs sku'i tha snyad khas mi len no/ /grol lam gyi gtso bo ni bden bzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug rtogs pa'i lam dang*/ khyad par gang zag rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod kyis stong bar rtogs pa'i ye shes so/ /mthong lam skad cig ma bco lnga po rim can du skye ba dang*/ bcu drug pa lam rjes shes sgom lam du 'dod do/ /gsum pa 'bras bu la/ sngar bshad pa'i lam gyi gtso bo de dag bsgoms pas/ /nyon mongs can gyi mi shes pa spangs pas dgra bcom pa dang*/ nyon mongs can min pa'i mi shes pa spangs pas sangs rgyas 'thob par 'dod la/ nyan thos kyi byang chub ni myur na tshe gsum la thob nus pa dang*/ rang rgyal gyi byang chub bskal ba brgya sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub bskal ba grangs med gsum gyis thob nus par 'dod/ nyan thos la dge 'dun nyi shu dang*/ zhugs gnas kyi rnam gzhag 'thad pa dang*/ dman pa'i dgra bcom spangs rtog las nyams nas rgyun zhugs su 'gyur srid pa'ang 'dod/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis po khas len kyang theg chen dang mi 'dra ba ni/ dang por byang chub tu sems bskyed pa nas bzungs te srod la bdud btul ba phan chad la so skye dang*/ de'i mtshan thog de nyid la mthong lam mngon du byas pa nas 'phags par 'dod la/ de yang 'pho ba nas rab tu byung ba ma mdzad kyi bar du khyim pa dang*/ de phyin chad ni rab tu byung ba dang mdzad pa yang de dang bstun nas khyim pa dang rab byung gi mdzad pa yang dngos gnas par 'dod/

mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe rig pa rgyun chad par khas len pas kyang*/ de phyin chad gzugs sku'i bkod pa ston par mi 'dod la/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud kyi zad mi skye shes pa'i ye shes ni sangs rgyas dkon mchog yin kyang*/ de'i gzugs phung de nyid sdug bsngal bden par 'dod pas sangs rgyas dkon mchog tu mi 'dod/ de bzhin du dge 'dun dkon mchog kyang slob pa 'phags pa rnams kyi thugs rgyud kyi lam bden la 'jog gi /gang zag de rnams dge 'dun dkon mchog tu mi 'dod do/ /'di dang mdo sde ba gnyis kyis phyi don yod par 'dod pas don smra zhes kyang grags so/ /gnyis pa mdo sde ba'i lugs la bzhi/ mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ dbye ba/ grub mtha' 'o/ /dang po ni/ rang rig dang phyi don gnyis ka khas len pa'i theg dman gyi grub mtha' smra ba'i gang zag de/ mdo sde ba'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i mdo tshad mar bzung nas de'i rjes su 'brang bas na mdo sde ba'o/ /gsum pa de la dbye na gnyis ste/ lung gi rjes 'brang dang*/ rigs pa'i rjes 'brang gi mdo sde ba'o/ /dang po ni/ mngon pa mdzod kyi rjes 'brang gi mdo sde ba lta bu/ gnyis pa ni tshad ma sde bdun gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i mdo sde ba lta bu'o/ /mngon pa sde bdun ni/ shā ri'i bus bsdus pa'i chos kyi phung bo zhes pa'i bstan bcos sogs bdun po de nyid yin la/ bye brag smra bas de rnams sangs rgyas kyis gang 'dod kyang*/ mdo sde pas dgra bcom pa de dang de dag gis bsdus pa yin gyi/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' min no zhes 'dod do/ /bzhi pa grub mtha' la gsum/ gzhi/ lam/ 'bras bu'o/ /dang po ni/ shes bya la bden pa gnyis su grangs nges par 'dod cing*/ don dam par don byed nus pa rnams/ don dam bden pa yin la/ de ltar mi nus pa'i chos rnams kun rdzob bden par 'dod de/ rnam 'grel las/

don dam don byed nus pa gang*/ /de 'dir don dam yod pa yin/ /gzhan ni kun rdzob yod pa ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de yang rgyu 'bras dang phan gnod sogs dngos po kho na'i steng nas 'thad kyi/ dngos med la de mi 'thad pas/ dngos po thams cad don dam par don byed nus par 'dod la/ de'i phyir dngos po/ rang mtshan/ 'dus byas/ don dam bden pa rnams don gcig pa dang*/ spyi mtshan/ 'dus ma byas kyi chos/ kun rdzob bden pa rnams don gcig go /gzhal bya la rang spyi gnyis su grangs nges pas/ tshad ma la mngon rjes gnyis su nges la/ gzhan yang yul dang yul can gyi dbye tshul shin du mang bo yod pa rnams rgyas par ni bsdus gzhung sogs gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /'di dang bye brag smra ba gnyis kas kun gzhi dang nyon yid mi 'dod la/ 'dod tshul thun mong ba phal cher ni sngar bshad pa ltar yin te/ phung bo khams skye mched rnams bye brag smra bas 'dod pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa lam la gnyis te/ spang bya ni bye smra dang mthun cing*/ lam gyi dmigs pa ni bden bzhi'i rnam pa mi rtag la sogs bcu drug po nyid yin la/ lam lnga'i dbye ba byed kyang*/ sa bcu dang longs sku'i rnam gzhag mi 'dod pa sngar bzhin no/ /'on kyang 'di la theg chen bkar 'dod pa zhig yod par gsungs pas/ de ltar na/ de nas bshad pa'i sa bcu dang longs sku'i rnam gzhag kyang khas len pa zhig yod par gsal lo/ /gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes ni/ grol lam gyi ngo bo dang*/ gang zag gi bdag med ni/ gang zag rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod kyis stong pa'i stong nyid lta bu la 'dod la/ stong nyid de yang de bzhin nyid dang*/ yongs grub kyang yin no/ /gzhan yang lam la byang phyogs so bdun/ rnam thar brgyad/ snyom 'jug dgu sogs kyang 'dod la/ sangs rgyas thob 'dod ni 'ga' zhig la yod kyang*/ rang nyid zhi bde gtso bor don gnyer gyi blo spong mi nus pas/

blo de sangs rgyas thob byed kyi nye rgyur mi 'gro bar tshad ldan gyi bshad pa yang mthong zhing*/ thabs khyad par can med kyang tha dad rtogs pa'i lam gtso bor bsgom pas rang lam gyi byang chub thob nus par 'dod do/ /gsum pa 'bras bu la/ nyon mongs can min pa'i mi shes pa tsam spangs pas dman pa'i dgra bcom dang*/ nyon mongs can dang nyon mongs min pa'i mi shes pa gnyis ka spong byed kyi lam zung 'brel du nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod do/ /'dis nyan thos la zhugs gnas kyi rnam gzhag kyang 'dod la/ mdor na 'di dang bye smra gnyis kyis gzhi la bden gnyis dang*/ lam la mi rtag sogs bcu drug rtogs pa'i lam dang*/ 'bras bu la dman pa'i byang chub dang rdzogs pa'i byang chub gnyis/ gzhan yang gzugs la rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs dang*/ tshad ma la mngon rjes gnyis sogs 'dod pa tsam du mtshungs kyang nang gses kyi khyad par yod par shes pa bya ste/ dper na bye smras 'dus ma byas/ rdul phran cha med sogs don dam bden par 'dod la/ mdo sde pas de rnams kun rdzob bden par 'dod pa dang*/ bye brag smra bas rnam par rig byed min pa'i gzugs gzugs dngos gnas par 'dod kyang*/ cig shos kyis kun btags pa'i gzugs su 'dod pa bzhin no/ /gsum pa sems tsam pa'i lugs la bzhi/ mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ dbye ba/ grub mtha'o/ /dang po ni/ phyi do khas mi len cing rang rig sogs dngos po bden grub tu khas len pa'i theg chen gyi grub mtha' smra ba'i gang zag de/ sems tsam pa'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ phyi don med cing*/ khams gsum po sems kyi bdag nyid tsam du smra bas na/ sems tsam pa'am/ rnam rig pa zhes bya la/ yang gzhan rnal 'byor spyod pa zhes kyang brjod do/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ dbyig gnyen/ phyogs glang*/ chos grags rnams so/ /gsum pa de la dbye na/

sems tsam rnam bden pa dang*/ rnam brdzun pa gnyis/ tshur mthong gi gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum la gzugs rags par snang ba ni/ rnam bden brdzun gnyis kyi rtsod pa'i gzhi yin pas/ rnam brdzun pas de la de ltar snang ba snang ba ltar ma grub par 'dod la/ rnam bden pas de ltar grub par 'dod do/ /rnam bden pa la yang*/ gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam/ sgo nga phyed tshal/ sna tshogs gnyis med pa dang gsum/ de yang kha dog khra bo 'dzin pa'i mig shes kyis de 'dzin pa'i tshe/ yul gyi ngos nas sngo ser sogs mi 'dra ba re re'i rnam pa gtad cing*/ yul can gyi ngos nas kyang sngo ser sogs mi 'dra ba re re'i rnam ldan du skyes bar 'dod pas na/ gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam dang*/ yang yul gyi ngos nas sngo ser sogs mi 'dra ba re re'i rnam pa gtad kyang*/ yul can gyi ngos nas sngo ser sogs mi 'dra ba re re'i rnam can du ma skyes par khra tsam gyi rnam ldan du skyes par 'dod pas na/ sgo nga phyed tshal dang*/ yang de ltar 'dzin pa'i tshe yul gyi ngos nas kyang sngau sogs mi 'dra ba re re'i rnam pa ma gtad cing khra tsam gyi rnam pa gtad/ yul can gyi ngos nas kyang sngo sogs mi 'dra ba re re'i rnam ldan du ma skyes par khra tsam gyi rnam ldan du skyes par 'dod pas na/ sna tshogs gnyis med pa zhes brjod do/ /rnam rdzun pa la yang*/ dri bcas rnam brdzun pa dang*/ dri med rnam rdzun pa gnyis yod/ de'i khyad par ni gzung 'dzin gyi shes pa'i ngo bo la dri mas bslad ma bslad kyi khyad par 'dod pa'i dbang gis so/ /'di dag la da dung nang gses kyi dbye bas du ma yod kyang mang du dogs la/ skabs 'dir ma zad/ mdo sde ba la yang gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam pa sogs gsum yod par bshad do/ / bzhi ba grub mtha' la gsum/ gzhi/ lam/ 'bras bu'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ yul dang yul can no/ /dang po ni/ shes bya la bden pa gnyis dang*/

mtshan nyid gsum gyi rnam gzhag mdzad kyang*/ don dam bden pa dang*/ chos nyid/ stong nyid/ chos dbyings/ gnas lugs rnams don gcig par 'dod/ don dam pa la sgras brjod rigs kyis dbye na/ gang zag gi bdag med phra mo dang*/ chos kyi bdag med phra mo gnyis/ dang po ni gang zag rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod kyis stong ba'i stong nyid lta bu ste 'di gzhan gyis don dam pa dngos yin par mi 'dod pa'i tshul yang yod/ gnyis pa ni gzugs dang de 'dzin pa'i tshad ma rdzas gzhan gyis stong ba'i stong nyid lta bu'o/ /'di rang rgyud pa sogs kyis don dam bden par mi 'dod kyang 'di pas don dam bden pa dang yongs grub tu 'dod do/ /rgyas par dbye na stong nyid bcu drug bco brgyad nyi shur 'byed la/ bsdu na stong nyid bzhi dang bden gnyis su'ang 'du'o/ /mtshan nyid gsum gyi nang nas gzhan dbang dang 'dus byas don gcig pa dang*/ stong nyid min pa'i 'dus ma byas rnams kun btags dang*/ stong nyid dang yongs grub don gcig /'di tsam zhig dbu ma ba yang 'dod kyang bden grub 'dod mi 'dod kyi khyad par che ste/ 'dis kun btags bden par ma grub cing*/ gzhan dbang dang yongs grub gnyis so so nas bden par grub par 'dod la/ dbu ma pas bden grub kyi chos yod par mi 'dod pa'i phyir/ de yang rgyu 'bras kyi rnam bzhag gzhan dbang la 'thad pas de bden par grub pa dang yongs grub 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag gi ngo bor bden pas de bden par grub pa'o/ /mtshan nyid gsum sogs gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag rnams ni/ mdo sde dgongs 'grel dang*/ mdo sde rgyan sogs dang*/ gzhan yang thogs med sku mched kyi gzhung du ma nas 'byung ba ltar ro/ / gnyis pa yul can la/ 'di ba la rnam shes rnam brgyad 'dod mi 'dod gnyis yod par bshad la/ 'dod pa rnams kyis mig gi rnam shes sogs drug dang*/ de'i steng du kun gzhi dang nyon yid gnyis bzhag pas brgyad 'dod

do/ /kun gzhi ni ngo bo lung ma bstan du gyur ba'i yid kyi rnam shes zhig tu 'dod la skye ba len pa po yin pas las 'bras kyi rten du gyur ba'i bdag yin par 'dod cing*/ nyon yid ni kun gzhi yang dmigs nas ngar 'dzin pa'i sems sgrib lung ma bstan zhig tu 'dod do/ /blo la tshad ma dang tshad min gyi blo gnyis 'dod cing*/ tshad ma la yang mngon sum tshad ma dang*/ rjes dpag tshad ma gnyis/ mngon sum tshad ma la/ dbang bo'i mngon sum/ yid kyi mngon sum rang rig mngon sum rnal 'byor mngon sum dang bzhir 'dod/ 'di tsam zhig ni/ mdo sde ba sems tsam pa dbu ma ba gsum mthun la/ 'on kyang khyad par yod de/ mdo sde bas mngon sum gyi tshad ma la ma 'khrul bas khyab par 'dod/ sems tsam pas tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi dbang mngon dang yid mngon rnams 'khrul shes su 'dod pa'i phyir/ de lta na'ang mngon sum la rtog bral gyis khyab pa khas len pa yin no/ / gnyis pa lam la gnyis/ spang bya dang*/ lam gyi rnam gzhag dngos so/ /dang po ni/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin sa bon dang bcas pa dang*/ rtsa nyon drug nye nyon nyi shu sogs nyon sgrib dang*/ gzugs phyi rol don 'dzin gyi rtog pa bden 'dzin du 'dod pas de dang de'i bag chags rnam shes sgrib dang*/ kun btags bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin sgrib pa yin kyang*/ dngos po bden par grub pas de bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin ni sgrib pa min no/ /gnyis pa ni/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba de bsod nams kyi tshogs chung ngu tsam gyis zin pa'i sgo nas gtso bor bsgoms pas nyan thos kyi rigs can gyis byang chub mngon du byed la/ 'bring gis rang rgyal gyi byang chub dang*/ gzugs 'dzin rdzas gzhan gyis stong ba'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba de gzhan don du bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen pos zin pa'i sgo nas nyams su blangs pas/ byang sems rnams kyis bla med byang chub mngon du byed do/

/gzugs 'dzin rdzas gzhan gyis stong ba'i don ni/ sngon po lta bu 'dzin pa'i rnam shes kyis de gzung don du byas pa'i tshe kun gzhi sogs kyis bzhag pa'i bag chags kyi dbang gis sngon po de rang 'dzin pa'i shes pa'i bdag nyid dam rdzas su skyes pa yin gyi/ de'i tshe sngon po lta bu de 'dzin pa'i shes pa las rdzas gzhan du med de/ dper na/ rmi lam du ring ba sogs snang ba'i tshe sems ma yin kyang sems kyi bdag nyid du gyur ba'i ri sogs yod cing*/ sems las don gzhan pa'i ri sogs med pa bzhin no/ /'di la lung rigs du ma yod kyang ma bris la 'di ba'i lugs kyi phyi don med tshul go dka' zhing*/ legs par go na byams pa'i chos gsum dang thogs med dbyig gnyen sogs kyis sems tsam pa'i lugs ji ltar bshad pa yang nges nus par snang la/ de ltar ma go na/ de yang legs par mi shes par gsal lo/ /zhugs gnas brgyad dang*/ lam lnga sa bcu'i rnam gzhag khas len pa'i dbu ma pa dang 'dra'o/ /gsum pa 'bras bu la/ lhag bcas lhag med myang 'das gsum dang*/ sku gsum gyi rnam gzhag kyang khas len la/ phal cher ni dbu sems thun mong ba yin par 'og tu 'chad do/ / mngon du byed tshul ni gong du rags tsam brjod pa bzhin dang*/ rgyas par ni gzhung gzhan dang*/ grub mtha'i khyad par rnams drang nges rnam 'byed na gsal zhing*/ myang 'das mngon du byed pa'i tshul ni mi 'dra ba gnyis yod de/ rnam bden pas theg dman dgra bcom pas rang lam gyi ltas med mngon du byas pa'i tshe rig pa rgyun chad par 'dod la/ rnam rdzun pa ltar na sdug kun rgyun chad kyang rig pa rgyun chad par mi 'dod de/ rig pa'i rgyun sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du 'gro bar 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang 'dis ni mthar thug theg pa gcig tu grub par 'dod pa dang*/ rnam bden pa mthar thug theg pa gsum du grub par 'dod pa'i dbang gis yin no/

/bzhi ba dbu ma pa la gsum/ mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bden grub kyi chos rdul tsam yang med par 'dod pa'i theg chen gyi grub mtha' smra ba'i gang zag de/ dbu ma'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba'i dngos po bden med du rtogs pa'i lta ba khas len pas na/ dbu ma ba dang*/ chos thams cad la bden par grub pa'i ngo bo cung zad kyang med par smra bas na ngo bo nyid med par smra ba'o/ / gsum pa de la dbye na/ rang rgyud pa dang*/ thal 'gyur ba gnyis yod/ dang po la bzhi/ mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ dbye ba/ grub mtha'o/ /dang po ni/ rang rgyud kyi rtags sam rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa'i rtags zhal gyis bzhes shing bden grub tha snyad du yang mi 'dod pa'i dbu ma ba de/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ rang rgyud kyi rtags zhal gyi bzhes pa'i dbu ma ba yin pas na/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa'o/ /gsum pa de la dbye na/ mdo sde spyod pa'i dbu ma rang rgyud pa dang*/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i de gnyis/ dang po ni slob dpon legs ldan 'byed dang*/ ye shes snying bo lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon zhi ba 'tsho/ kā ma la shī la/ seng bzang lta bu'o/ /bzhi ba grub mtha' la gsum/ gzhi/ lam/ 'bras bu'o/ /dang po ni/ grub mtha' 'og ma dang thun mong ba'i 'dod tshul dang khyad par sems tsam pa dang 'dod tshul thun mong ba phal cher ni sngar bshad zin la/ 'di bas bden grub mi 'dod kyang*/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa dang*/ rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa/ rang ngos nas grub gsum tha snyad du yod par 'dod/ legs ldan 'byed sogs mdo sde spyod pa'i dbu ma rang rgyud pa ltar na/ sngon po lta bu ni/ de 'dzin gyi shes pa las ngo bo tha dad cing phyi rol gyi don yin par 'dod/ zhi 'tsho sogs rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma ba ltar na/ sems tsam pas 'dod pa ltar sngon po lta bu rang 'dzin pa'i shes pa dang ngo bo gcig gam bdag nyid gcig tu 'dod

do/ /'on kyang sems tsam pas shes pa bden grub 'dod cing 'dis mi 'dod pa bshad zin la/ phyi don 'dod pa'i dbu ma bas ni rang rig mi 'dod cing*/ zhi 'tsho'i rjes 'brang rnams kyis rang rig khas len no/ /gzhan yang phyi don 'dod pas phyi rol don gyis stong ba'i stong nyid dang*/ de rtogs pa'i ye shes kyang mi 'dod la/ phyi don med par 'dod na de khas len rigs so/ /shes bya la bden pa gnyis su grangs nges par 'dod cing*/ bum pa bden stong de don dam bden pa'i don dang*/ bum pa ni kun rdzob bden pa'i mtshan gzhi'o/ /don dam bden pa la rgyas par phye na sems tsam pa dang mthun la/ kun rdzob la yang dag kun rdzob dang*/ log pa'i kun rdzob gnyis su 'byed de/ de yang chu dang byad bzhin lta bu ni/ yang dag kun rdzob dang*/ smig rgyu'i chu dang byad bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan lta bu ni log pa'i kun rdzob tu 'dod do/ /tshad ma dang tshad min gyi shes pa'i rnam gzhag mdo sde spyod pa'i dbu ma ba rnams ni/ mdo sde ba dang mthun pa shugs che la/ rnal 'byor spyod pa rnams ni/ sems tsam pa dang mthun pa shas che'o/ /'di gnyis kas gang zag tha snyad btags pa'i btags don btsal ba'i tshe rnyed par 'dod pas gang zag gi yid kyi rnam shes gang zag gi mtshan gzhi yin par bzhed do/ /mtshan nyid gsum 'dod tshul ni sems tsam pa dang mthun tsam yin kyang*/ mtshan gzhi la mi 'dra ba yod de/ 'di bas bum pa bden stong yongs grub kyi mtshan nyid par 'dod cing*/ cig shos kyis mi 'dod pas so/ /mtshan nyid gsum ni/ bum pa la sogs pa'i 'dus byas rnams ni gzhan dbang yin la/ de dag la bden par sgro btags pa'i cha ni kun btags dang*/ btags pa ltar ma grub pa'i stong nyid ni yongs grub tu 'jog go /gnyis pa lam la gnyis/ lam gyi spang bya dang*/ lam gyi rnam gzhag dngos so/ /gang zag rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa rnams gang zag gi bdag 'dzin dang*/

nyon sgrib yin la rnal 'byor spyod pa'i rang rgyud pa ltar na gzugs phyi rol don 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang*/ bden 'dzin rnams shes sgrib yin no/ /der ma zad nyon mongs rnams kyi sa bon thams cad nyon sgrib yin la/ de'i bag chags dang bden 'dzin gyi bag chags sogs shes sgrib bau/ /gnyis pa lam dngos la/ theg pa gsum rang rang gi lam la tshogs lam sogs lnga re yod la/ mdo sde spyod pa'i dbu ma ltar na/ nyan rang gnyis kas gtso bor nyon sgrib spong bar mtshungs shing*/ thob bya yang mchog dman cher med kyang*/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma pas/ nyan thos kyis gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i lam gtso bor bsgoms nas gang zag gi bdag 'dzin spangs pa'i myang 'das mngon du byed/ rang rgyal gyi rigs can gyis gzugs dang gzugs 'dzin pa'i tshad ma rdzas gzhan du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa spang bya'i tsho gtso bor byas nas spong ba dang de'i gnyen po bsgoms pas/ de 'dra'i rtog pa dang nyon sgrib gnyis ka spangs pa'i thar ba mngon du byed par 'dod do/ /'on kyang 'dis phyi rol don 'jig rten gyi rtog pa bden 'dzin rags par 'dod kyang bden 'dzin du mi 'dod de/ phyi rol don gyis stong ba'i stong nyid rtogs pas/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i go mi chod par 'dod pa'i phyir te/ de 'dra'i stong nyid de chos kyi bdag med rags pa yin gyi/ chos kyi bdag med phra mo'am stong nyid phra mo ma yin pa'i phyir zhes 'dod do/ /lam dang 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag gzhan ni thal 'gyur ba'i skabs su bshad par bya'o/ /gsum pa 'bras bu la/ nyan thos la zhugs gnas brgyad kyi rnam gzhag byed kyang*/ rang rgyal la de mi byed/ myang 'das la lhag bcas sogs gsum las/ lhag bcas myang 'das ni sdug bsngal gyi phung bo dang lhag med ni de las bzlog par 'dod cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i myang 'das rnams mi gnas pa'i myang 'das so/

/stong nyid phra mo rtogs pa'i lam de tshogs gnyis rgya chen pos zin pa'i sgo nas bskal ba grangs med gsum sogs su yun ring du bsrings te bsgoms pas byang chub chen po thob par 'dod do/ /gnyis pa thal 'gyur pa'i lugs la gsum/ mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ grub mtha' 'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa tha snyad du'ang zhal gyis mi bzhes pa'i dbu ma de/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ sangs rgyas skyangs dang*/ zla ba grags pa/ rje bla ma lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ thal 'gyur gyi sgo nas phyi rgol gyi rgyud la bsgrub bya rtogs pa'i rjes dpag skye bar 'dod pa'i dbu ma pa yin pas na/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'o/ /gsum pa grub mtha'i 'dod tshul la gsum/ gzhi/ lam/ 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag go /dang po ni/ shes bya la bden pa gnyis dang*/ mngon lkog gnyis sogs 'byed la/ don dam bden pa dang*/ stong nyid don gcig cing*/ dbye ba ni sngar bzhin la/ mtshan gzhi ni/ myu gu rang bzhin gyis med pa lta bu'o/ /kun rdzob la yang dag kun rdzob dang*/ log pa'i kun rdzob gnyis su mi 'byed kyang*/ 'jig rten shes ngo la ltos te yang log gnyis kyi dbye ba 'byed de/ byad bzhin de 'jig rten shes ngo la ltos te yang dag dang*/ me long nang gi byad bzhin gzugs brnyan de la ltos te log pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang don bsdus na 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyus ma bslad pa'i dbang bo yul dang bcas pa ni/ shes ngo de la ltos te yang dag dang*/ des bslad pa'i dbang po drug yul dang bcas pa ni/ de la ltos te log pa ste/ dper na/ dung dkar dkar bor mthong ba'i dbang bo yul dang bcas pa dang*/ dung dkar ser bor snang ba'i dbang bo yul dang bcas pa lta bu'o/ /gzhan yang 'di ba la khas len tshul du ma yod de/ rang bzhin gyis stong ba rten 'brel gyi don du mthong nas/ rang gi mtshan nyid gyi grub pa khas mi len pa dang*/

de bzhin du rang rgyud/ rang rig /kun gzhi nyon yid rdul phran phyogs kyi cha med rnams khas mi len la/ ming brdas bzhag tsam phyi don/ bden 'dzin nyon sgrib yin pa dang*/ bdag med gnyis la phra rags mi 'byed pa dang*/ 'gog bden rnams don dam bden pa dang*/ 'phags pa la stong nyid rtogs myong gis khyab pa dang*/ so skye'i shes pa thams cad 'khrul shes dang*/ zhig pa dngos por 'dod pa sogs du ma yod cing*/ shes pa'i rnam gzhag gzhan phal cher ni rang rgyud pa dang mthun tsam yin kyang*/ dpyad shes rnams tshad ma dang*/ yid kyi mngon sum dang rtog pa'i gzhi mthun yod par 'dod do/ /gang zag rdzas yod pa mi bzhed de/ gzhi grub na btags yod yin pas khyab par bzhed pa'i phyir ro/ /dngos po bzhed kyang rang mtshan mi 'dod de/ rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa mi bzhed pa'i phyir ro/ /de mi bzhed kyang ming rkyang btags yod tsam la bya byed kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan du 'jog shes pas/ phung bo la brten nas btags pa'i nga tsam zhig ni gang zag gi mtshan gzhir bzhed do/ /gang zag rang bzhin med pa/ gang zag gi bdag med phra mo dang*/ phung bo rang bzhin med pa chos kyi bdag med phra mor 'dod kyi/ gang zag rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod kyis stong ba'i stong nyid/ gang zag gi bdag med phra mor mi 'dod de/ de gang zag gi bdag med rags pa yin pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir 'di dag gi khyad par cung zad tsam zhig brjod par bya ste/ 'di la gnyis/ rang bzhin med pa'i don dang*/ rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod kyis stong ba'i don no/ /dang po ni/ rang rgyud pas gang zag sogs chos rnams ming brda' 'am rtog pa'i dbang tsam gyis 'jog mi nus pas/ blo gnod med la snang ba'i dbang gis 'jog la/ de yang gang zag 'jog byed kyi blo gnod med des 'jog rgyu'i gang zag ni/ blo de la ltos med kyi tshul gyis dang bo nyid nas kyang rang gi ngos nas grub grub pa zhig la 'dod cing*/

de ltar grub pa de gang zag rang ngos nas sam rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i don yin kyang bden par grub pa'i don yin par mi 'dod/ thal 'gyur ba ni gang zag de kho rang 'jal byed kyi tshad ma la ltos med kyis dang po nas ma grub par gang zag dang gang zag 'jal byed kyi tshad ma gnyis phan tshun bltos nas grub pas/ 'jog byed ming brda'am rtog pas bzhag pa la ma bltos par rang gi ngos nas grub pa zhig byung na gang zag rang bzhin gyis grub pa dang*/ rang ngos nas grub par 'jog la/ der ma grub pa de gang zag gi bdag med phra mor bzhed/ de bzhin du chos gzhan la yang rig pa sbyor te/ phung bo zhang bum sogs rang bzhin med pa chos kyi bdag med phra mo yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang sde gnas ma bu pas/ gang zag rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi khyad par gsum po des stong ba gang zag gi bdag med phra mor 'dod la/ de las gzhan pa'i bye brag smra ba phal cher dang*/ mdo sde ba/ sems tsam pa/ rang rgyud pa rnams kyis rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod kyis stong ba nyid/ gang zag gi bdag med phra mor 'dod cing*/ gang zag rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod kyi 'dzin tshul dang grub tshul ni/ rang bzhin gyis grub par 'dzin pa'i steng nas gang zag ni rang gi phung bo la phar mi bltos pa'i dbang sgyur ba po'i rje bo lta bu dang*/ phung bo rnams gang zag la tshur bltos pa'i dbang bsgyur bya'i khol bau ltar 'dzin pa ni/ gang zag rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod kyi 'dzin tshul dang*/ des bzung ba ltar grub na rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod du grub par 'jog go /de yang phung bo la bltos med du yan gar ba zhig byung na rang rkya thub pa yin pas/ rang rkya thub mi thub ni gang zag rang ldog nas yin gyi/ gzhi ldog la min pa'i 'dod tshul yod de/ yid kyi rnam shes gang zag tu 'dod pa rnams kyis de rdzas yod du 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa lam gyi rnam gzhag la/

lam lnga sa bcu sogs mang cher ni sngar dang 'dra zhing*/ 'dir gong du ma bshad pa 'ga' zhig kyang rgyas par 'chad la/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba thun mong min pa'i khyad par ni sngar bshad cing 'chad par yang byed do/ /des na lam gyi spang bya dang*/ lam gyi rnam gzhag dngos dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ dngos po bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin sogs bden 'dzin sa bon dang bcas pa nyon sgrib yin la/ theg pa che chung gi dgra bcom pa thams cad kyis spangs par 'dod pas/ rang rgyud pa ltar bden 'dzin rnams shes sgrib tu byas te/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sa dgu la ni chen po yi/ zhes sogs kyis bshad pa ltar bden 'dzin che 'bring chung ngu dgu theg chen sgom lam bar med lam dgu bos rim gyis spong ba'i rnam gzhag rnams mi bzhed do/ / yang theg dman dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa sngon du song ba rnams kyis bden 'dzin sogs nyon sgrib thams cad theg dman lam gyi gnas skabs su spangs kyang*/ dang po nyid nas theg chen du rigs nges pa'i byang sems rnams kyis sa brgyad pa thob pa dang dus mnyam du spangs par 'dod la/ shes sgrib ni/ nyon mongs de dag gi bag chags sam gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i bag chags la byas nas de spangs pa dang sangs rgyas pa dus mnyam par bzhed do/ /rang rgyud pa sogs rang sde grub mtha' smra ba shes sgrib khas len pa dag gis nyon sgrib la kun btags dang lhan skyes gnyis yod pa de bzhin du shes sgrib la yang de gnyis yod par 'dod kyang*/ 'di ba'i lugs la nyon sgrib la kun btags dang lhan skyes gnyis sam/ mthong spang*/ sgom spang gnyis bzhed kyang*/ shes sgrib ni mthong spang kun btags med cing*/ sgom spangs dang lhan skyes kyis khyab par 'dod do/ /kun btags dang lhan skyes kyi khyad par yang grub mthas blo kha bsgyur ba la ma ltos par rang gi rang gis skye ba ni lhan skyes dang*/ des blo kha bsgyur ba'i dbang gis byung ba ni kun btags so/

/gnyis pa lam la gnyis/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ phye ba so sor bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ de la dbye na/ nyan thos kyi tshogs lam/ sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ sgom lam/ mi slob lam ste lnga/ de bzhin du rang rgyal/ theg chen la sbyar bas lnga gsum bco lnga'o/ /de rnams mngon du byed tshul kyang*/ dang por tshogs lam/ de nas sbyor mthong*/ de nas sgom lam/ de nas mi slob lam mngon du byed pa'i rim pa nges la/ tshogs lam la yang*/ tshogs lam chung 'bring che gsum/ sbyor lam la yang sbyor lam drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/ chos mchog bzhi mngon du byed pa'i go rim nges so/ /mthong lam la shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug yod la/ de yang shes pa brgyad dang*/ bzod pa brgyad do/ /shes pa brgyad ni/ sdug bsngal chos shes/ rjes shes gnyis/ de bzhin du kun 'byung*/ 'gog pa/ lam gsum ste bden bzhi so so la sbyor/ bzod pa brgyad ni/ sdug bsngal chos bzod/ rjes bzod gnyis/ de bzhin du/ kun 'byung 'gog pa lam la yang sbyar ro/ /yang mthong lam la mnyam gzhag ye shes dang*/ rjes thob ye shes gnyis/ dang po la'ang*/ bar chad med lam dang rnam grol lam gnyis yod/ bzod pa brgyad dang mthong lam bar chad med lam don gcig cing*/ shes pa brgyad dang mthong lam rnam grol lam don gcig go /gzhan yang theg pa chen po'i lam la sa bcu yod de/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba/ gnyis pa dri ma med pa/ gsum pa 'od byed pa/ bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba/ lnga pa sbyang dka' ba/ drug pa mngon du gyur ba/ bdun pa ring du song ba/ brgyad pa mi g.yo ba/ dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros/ bcu pa chos kyi sprin no/ /de las dang po'i ngo bor gyur pa'i mthong sgom gyi lam gnyis yod/ mthong lam ni sngar ltar dang*/ de'i ngo bor gyur pa'i sgom lam la bar chad med lam yod par 'dod pa ni mi mthun pa cher med la/ sa de'i ngo bor gyur pa'i sgom lam rnam grol lam dang sgom lam rjes thob ye shes yod med mi mthun kyang*/

rnam bshad ltar na yod par gsal lo/ /sa bcu bo so so la mnyam rjes gnyis gnyis yod la/ sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar thob ma thag pa'i ye shes rnams rnam grol lam dang bar chad med lam gnyis ka yin no/ /sa bcu gcig pa kun tu 'od ni sangs rgyas kyi sa yin la/ de rnam grol lam du 'dod mi 'dod pa'i tshul gnyis snang ngo*/ /gnyis pa phye ba so sor bshad pa ni/ theg pa che chung gnyis dang thun mong ba'i lam ni/ mi dge ba ma skyes pa mi bskyed pa'i yang dag spong ba/ de bzhin du skyes zin spong ba/ dge ba ma skyes pa bskyed pa/ skyes zin spel bar byed pa'i yang dag spong ba ni yang dag spong ba bzhi/ 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba brtson 'grus kyi de sems kyi de dang dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba ste bzhi/ dad pa/ brtson 'grus/ dran pa/ ting 'dzin/ shes rab kyi dbang bo lnga/ yang dad pa brtson 'grus dran pa ting 'dzin shes rab kyi stobs te stobs lnga/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag /chos rab tu rnam 'byed yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag /de bzhin du brtson 'grus/ dga' ba/ shin du sbyangs pa/ ting 'dzin/ btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ste byang chub kyi yan lag bdun/ yang dag pa'i lta ba/ yang dag pa'i rtogs pa/ yang dag pa'i ngag de'i las kyi mtha'/ de'i 'tsho ba/ de'i rtsol ba/ de'i dran pa/ yang dag pa'i ting 'dzin te 'phags lam yan lag brgyad dang bcas so bdun ni theg chen pa la yang yod pas de dang thun mong ba'o/ /yang byams pa snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms te tshad med khyad par can bzhi/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong ba nyid dang*/ mtshan med dang*/ smon med ste rnam thar sgo gsum/ gzugs med dang po sogs gzugs med bzhi'i rnam thar bzhi/ gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ gzugs med gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ sdug pa'i rnam thar/ 'gog pa'i rnam thar te rnam thar brgyad/

bsam gtan bzhi gzugs med bzhi 'gog pa'i snyom 'jug ste snyom 'jug dgu / lha'i mig gi mngon shes/ lha'i rna ba'i de/ gzhan sems shes pa'i de/ sngon gnas rjes dran gyi de/ rdzu 'phrul gyi de/ zag zad kyi mngon shes te mngon shes drug /sha'i spyan/ lha'i de/ shes rab kyi de/ chos kyi de/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan te spyan lnga/ gzhan yang bden bzhi shes pa sogs shes pa bcu/ lha rjes su dran pa sogs rjes dran drug /sbyin sogs phar phyin drug /zad par sa'i skye mched sogs zad par bcu/ zil gnon brgyad/ tshe la dbang ba sogs dbang bcu/ gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pa sogs bcu/ bar/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ so sor yang dag pa rig pa bzhi/ ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nyer gzhag gsum/ bsrung ba med pa gsum/ ma 'dres pa bco brgyad sogs/ nyan rang byang sems rnams dang thun mong dang thun mong min pa ci rigs yod kyang so so phye na mang du dogs so/ /gsum pa 'bras bu la/ nyan thos la zhugs gnas brgyad kyi rnam gzhag kyang 'byed la/ myang 'das la lhag bcas lhag med mi gnas pa'i myang 'das gsum/ lhag bcas lhag med kyi don ni rang rgyud pa ltar mi 'jog par bden snang gi lhag ma dang bcas ma bcas dang*/ myang 'das gnyis kyi nang nas dang por lhag med myang 'das thob dgos par bzhed/ theg chen la sku gsum mdzad pa 'phrin las dang bcas pa rnams 'di par ma zad/ rang rgyud pa dang sems tsam las kyang khas len no/ /sku gsum ni/ chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum mo/ /chos sku la gnyis te/ spangs pa chos sku dang*/ rtogs pa chos sku'o/ /dang po ni/ ngo bo nyid sku dang gnyis pa ni ye shes chos sku ste rnam mkhyen dang don gcig /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni gnas nges pa 'og min kho nar bzhugs pa sogs nges pa lnga ldan yin la/ de las sku nges pa ni/ phyag zhabs 'khor los mtshan pa sogs mtshan so gnyis dang sen mo zangs mdog sogs dpe byad brgyad bcu mnga' ba yin no/

/gsung ni/ mnyem 'jam sogs yan lag drug bcu rtsa bzhi dang*/ thugs ni shes bya'i rnam pa kun mkhyen pa ste/ de la brgya dang bcu'am sngar bshad pa bzhin yod la/ ldog chas dbye na dpag tu med do/ / sprul sku la gsum ste/ bzo ba dang pi wang brdung mkhan sogs su sprul pa'i bzo bo sprul sku/ lha mi phal pa lta bu dang*/ ri dwags dang ljon shing gru zam sogs su sprul ba'i skye ba sprul sku/ 'on kyang sprul gzhi rang gi sku'i cha dang gzhan la'ang mdzad pa gnyis ka yod pas zhib cha dgos so/ /mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyis tshul ston pa'i mchog gi sprul sku gsum/ phyi ma 'di la'ang mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa dgos te/ dper na bdag cag gi ston pa bzhin no/ /mdzad pa 'phrin las ni 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ste/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ bum pa bzang bo/ dpag bsam gyi shing las rnam rtog dang 'bad pa med par 'dod rgu 'byung ba ltar ro/ /sku gsum mdzad pa dang bcas pa rgyas par ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ mdo sde rgyan/ rgyud bla ma/ rin chen 'phreng ba/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'grel pa las shes par bya'o/ /'bras bu mngon du byed tshul ni/ gzhi dus su bden gnyis kyi rnam gzhag shes pa'i sgo nas lam dus su tshogs gnyis zung 'brel du nyams su blangs nas 'bras dus su chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis zung 'jug tu thob par bzhed do/ /smras pa/ de ltar thun mong grub mtha'i rgya mtsho las/ /cha shas zeg ma tsam zhig bkod pa 'di/ /rma bya'i mdongs kyi kha dog sna tshogs ltar/ /legs pa'i cha bsags du mas rnam par bkra/ /shin du bsdus na brjod don mi rdzogs shing*/ /spros na tshig tshogs rgya cher 'gyur ba dang*/ /blo dman 'jug par dka' bar legs mthong nas/ /ji ltar 'tsham par go sla'i ngag gis smras/ /tshul 'di mkhas pa'i bshad srol du ma dang*/ /'brel bar dpyad cing gdeng ldan bkod pas na/ /nyes par brjod pa'i dri ma cher med kyang*/

/'khrul gang 'phags dang mkhas pa'i spyan sngar 'chags/ /legs par bshad las thob pa'i dge ba ni/ /gangs ri'i tog ltar gang zhig mchis pa de/ /'gro blo'i yid kyi mun pa sel ba dang*/ /kun mkhyen ye shes 'grub pa'i rgyur bsngo'o/ /ces grub mtha' kun gyi snying bo'i don bsdus pa blo gsal 'jug pa'i khang bzang zhes bya ba 'di ni mdo sngags kyi gzhung dang man ngag du ma la mkhyen rab yangs pa'i gnas brtan rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo zhes bgyi bas/ 'di lta bu zhig gyis dang kho bos mthun rkyen mtha' dag sbyar nas bar du bsgrub po zhes bskul ba la brten nas/ grub mtha'i khyad par du ma rig pa shākya'i dge slong grags pa bshad sgrub ces bya bas/ co ne'i gzim khang nang nyid du nye bar sbyar ba'o// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/grub mtha' kun gyi snying po'i don bsdus pa blo gsal 'jug pa'i khang bzang bzhugs/ - PAGE 328-- PAGE 327-- PAGE 326-
